verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
We fall down
We lay our crowns
At the feet of Jesus

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
The greatness of
His Mercy and love
At the feet of Jesus

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
And we cry holy, holy, holy
And we cry holy, holy, holy
And we cry holy, holy, holy
Is the lamb

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
No more fears
You've dried our tears
At the feet of Jesus

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Grace abounds
To all who have found
The feet of Jesus
